item.title: ISL 2025-26: Odisha To Host Inter Kashi In Their First Match Of Season
item.description: Inter Kashi Head Coach: Odisha FC will host newly-promoted Inter Kashi FC in their first match of Indian Super League (ISL) 2025-26, which will be played at the Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar, on Tuesday. This will be Odisha's first match of the season at home after their opening fixture against Punjab FC on February 16 was postponed.

item.title: Hope Backs Brandon King Despite Lean Patch as West Indies Storm to 107-Run Win
item.description: West Indies skipper Shai Hope backs opener Brandon King despite his poor run of form after Shimron Hetmyer’s explosive 85 powered a 107-run win over Zimbabwe in the T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 clash.

item.title: Chennaiyin FC Suffer 2-0 Defeat to Mohun Bagan in ISL 2026 Away Clash
item.description: Chennaiyin FC went down 2-0 to Mohun Bagan Super Giant at Salt Lake Stadium in their second ISL 2026 match, with Clifford Miranda’s side now eyeing a comeback against Odisha FC.

item.title: 1st ODI: Pratika Returns, Healy Back At Helm For Australia As India Opt To Bat
item.description: The Gabba: India won the toss and elected to bat first against Australia in the first ODI of the three-game series here at The Gabba on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump Talks Football, Instinct In Podcast
item.description: US President Donald Trump: US President Donald Trump used a wide-ranging interview on a college football podcast to criticise new rules in the sport, reflect on hiring decisions in government, and speak about instinct, loyalty, and leadership.

item.title: Ranji Trophy Final: J&K; Opt To Bat First Against Karnataka
item.description: KSCA Hubli Cricket Ground: Jammu and Kashmir have won the toss and opted to bat first against eight-time champions Karnataka in the Ranji Trophy final here at the KSCA Hubli Cricket Ground on Tuesday.

item.title: Sesko's Strike Takes Man Utd To Fourth In Premier League Table
item.description: Hill Dickinson Stadium: Benjamin Sesko scored from the bench yet again as Manchester United edged out Everton 1-0 at Hill Dickinson Stadium to secure a fifth victory in six outings under Michael Carrick

item.title: AUS Vs IND: Ellyse Perry, Kim Garth Ruled Out Of ODI Series Due To Quad Injuries
item.description: ODI World Cup: Australia all-rounder Ellyse Perry and ace pacer Kim Garth have been ruled out of the three-match ODI series against India owing to the quad injuries that they picked up during the third and final T20I in Adelaide on Saturday.

item.title: Squash: Brabourne Stadium To Host Indian Open From March 18-22
item.description: The Indian Open: The Indian Open, a PSA Copper events, is scheduled to be be held from March 18 to 22 at the historic CCI Brabourne Stadium for its second edition, tickets for which are now live.

item.title: T20 WC: India Staring At Uphill Task After Windies’ Win Shakes Up The Group 1
item.description: T20 World Cup: India's Super 8 campaign at the T20 World Cup 2026 has hit turbulence early, leaving them with no room for missteps in the matches to come. A crushing 76-run loss to South Africa in Ahmedabad on Sunday has pushed them onto the back foot in Group 1, where they are competing alongside South Africa, the West Indies and Zimbabwe.
